headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1/H2. Do not center align unless necessary. Creates an organic, high-end editorial feel.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible sans-serif for inputs, rows, labels, and microcopy.

monospace.usage: Use for all numeric amounts, calculations, and currency (R) to ensure decimal alignment and a fintech-precision vibe.

colors.theme: Light theme preferred (cream/sage), with a complementary dark theme.
colors.guidelines: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutral greys with the earthy tone. Positive remaining balance should be Sage/Success, negative should be Terracotta/Destructive.

layouts.page: Single column scrollable layout with a constrained max-width (e.g., max-w-4xl) to keep lines readable.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, gap-8. Sections should be clearly separated by large margins (mt-12 or mt-16).
layouts.summaryCard: Place a sticky or prominent summary card at the top or bottom using 'Clay & Crisp' neumorphic style or 'Crystal Glass' if sticky. Needs to clearly highlight Total Income, Total Expenses, and Remaining Balance.
layouts.sections: Group Income, Individual Expenses, Household Expenses, Savings, and Emergency Fund clearly with H2 headers and subtle dividers. Do not use standard Bootstrap column grids.

surfaces.cards: Neumorphism (The 'Tactile' Variant) - Background matches parent or slightly off-white, two subtle ambient shadows, sharp 1px border to ground it.
surfaces.inputs: Flat background with 1px border. Focus state must have higher contrast ring (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).
surfaces.glass: If the summary card is sticky, use Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 (or dark equivalent) with a delicate border.

motion.buttons: Hover states must lift (-translate-y-0.5) and add shadow. Active states must press down.
motion.rows: When adding a new expense row, animate it in using framer-motion (e.g., height 0 to auto, opacity 0 to 1).
motion.values: Use animated number counters for the summary card if possible, or smooth fade transitions when numbers change.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Ensure Terracotta and Sage colors are dark enough against Cream background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-household-expense', data-testid='person-a-income').

component_guidelines.shadcn: Use Shadcn components for Inputs, Buttons, and Selects, but strip 'Vercel-look'. Rounding should be md or lg to feel softer and organic. Customise tailwind colors.
component_guidelines.icons: Use lucide-react for warm, soft icons (e.g., Plus, Trash, Wallet).
component_guidelines.forms: Inputs must clearly show which person they belong to. Inline editable labels for 'Person A' and 'Person B' using a transparent input or click-to-edit.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion and lucide-react if not already present.
Implement the React state locally and sync to localStorage on every change using a custom hook (useLocalStorage).
Format all currency values explicitly using the selected currency symbol (default 'R'). Ensure numbers are formatted with commas for thousands.
Create inline-editable labels for 'Person A' and 'Person B' that update globally across the app.
The Remaining balance must dynamically change color: Green/Sage if >= 0, Red/Terracotta if < 0.
Use JetBrains Mono or a monospace font for all numeric input fields and summary numbers so they align cleanly.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and total displays.
Implement the layout with a sticky Summary Header/Footer that tracks the scroll, so the user always sees their balance.
Ensure all components are implemented using .js/.jsx files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or sonner.jsx.
